review_scope: Only plan_flow/after_stop/propose_rebind local orchestration and metadata projection. No production Native execution or proof validation was attempted.

findings.finding: The adapter imports only copy and performs pure dictionary checks/projections. No transport, subprocess, original module loader, service command, filesystem read/write, checkpoint generation or Native construction is present. Step strings are inert.

No-owner cold route requires declared no-live-owner evidence, pinned checkpoint/source boot, explicit allow_new_kernel_boot and current_kernel_domain_consumed exactly False. It uses original load_new_boot_checkpoint/commit_new_boot/restore-adopt actions and contains neither normal-stop nor same-boot final validation.

The planner refuses missing prior normal-stop/full-history availability and requires same_boot_seed_consumed exactly False. Its first resume-specific step is to validate the actual existing same-boot stop/full-history evidence. Availability is a caller declaration, not a verified proof; that original validation must run before attach.

after_stop rejects every status except CAMERA_STOPPED_NEW_FINAL_PRESENT; even that status requires single normal-stop, forced_action False and a fresh-final declaration. It only returns the original-validator next step with execution/Native validation False. It does not retry or start.

The exact actual owner/config/provenance keys are required. Observed source paths must equal historical paths union explicit approved deltas union actual current config. Historical entries must preserve their hashes unless explicitly approved; no historical path can disappear. Deep copy preserves identity/gallery/memory/policy and every other non-owner field. Only owner/config fields and the observed source map are projected.

Planner/after_stop outputs say production execution and Native validation False. Rebind output says original metadata verify, production apply and Native proof creation False. The adapter creates no seed, consumed-domain marker, archive/restore receipt or verified checkpoint. Any copied selected candidate remains unverified until the original live selected verifier and original Native path run; synthetic booleans/strings are intentionally not valid Native evidence.

minimal_integration_requirements: Treat observation booleans and pin presence as unverified caller declarations. Obtain real fresh owner/provenance and actual prior stop/full-history evidence through the original live validators before any attach/start.
Preserve pending-stop state in the caller and use after_stop; do not recompute an initial maintenance plan and resubmit normal stop while a stop is pending.

Apply a proposed selected binding only after original live metadata verification and the caller-reviewed CAS; keep every False/unverified result marker. No code fix is requested within this local-only adapter scope.
